title: Project

timezone_id.description: Default TZ database timezone ID; see [List of tz database time zones Wikipedia article](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones).

url_slug.description: Unique string used as a component of the project's URL in the Telerivet web app (required length: 3-18 characters)

default_route_id.description: The ID of a basic route or custom route that will be used to send messages by default (via both the API and web app), unless a particular route ID is specified when sending the message.

primary_dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard that is shown by default when opening the project in the Telerivet web app, or `default` if the project's dashboards have never been customized (see Dashboard).

auto_create_contacts.description: If true, a contact will be automatically created for each unique phone number that a message is sent to or received from. If false, contacts will not automatically be created (unless contact information is modified by an automated service). The Conversations tab in the web app will only show messages that are associated with a contact.

message_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain messages in this project. Messages older than this will be automatically deleted. If null, messages will be retained forever.

short_link_scheme.description: If true (the default), short links in messages will include the scheme (e.g., 'https://rvt.me/xxxxxxxxx'). If false, short links will not include the scheme (e.g., 'rvt.me/xxxxxxxxx').

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this project. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this project belongs to

url.description: URL to this project in the Telerivet web app

description: Represents a Telerivet project. Provides methods for sending and scheduling messages, as well as accessing, creating and updating a variety of entities, including contacts, messages, scheduled messages, groups, labels, phones, services, and data tables.
